name: lyamfi-mobile
description: Lyamfi native iOS and Android shell, home-screen widgets and store builds

scripts.build:android: npm run assets && npx cap add android && npm run prepare:android && npx cap sync android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npm run assets && npx cap add ios && npm run prepare:ios && npx cap sync ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
